name: mcp-marmiton
description: MCP server for Marmiton. Search recipes, read ingredients and steps, and scale quantities to any number of servings. No API key required.
long_description: Search French recipes, read ingredients and steps, and rescale quantities to any number of servings. No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Find recipes by dish or ingredient.

query.description: What to search for, in French, for example 'tarte aux pommes'.

limit.description: Maximum recipes to return from this page of results.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read one recipe, optionally rescaled to a number of servings.

id.description: Marmiton recipe id, as returned by search_recipes. Preferred over 'url'.

url.description: Full marmiton.org recipe URL. Only marmiton.org is accepted. Ignored when 'id' is given.

servings.description: Rescale the ingredients to this many servings. Omit to get the recipe exactly as published.

tools.name: scale_ingredients
tools.description: Rescale any ingredient list, without contacting any website.

ingredients.description: Ingredient lines, for example ['200 g de farine', '3 oeufs', 'sel'].

factor.description: Multiplier to apply. Use this or the from/to pair.

from_servings.description: How many servings the list is written for.
